svg.aria-label: The path: lanes against time, with a now line at September 22, 2026. A ship-fence band under the axis says the fence STANDS: the W4 first-cut issues are done but FIX-1407 is In Review, so no W5 ship ticket may open; polish may start now. Two input lanes carry the W3 floor and the W4 first cut, both reaching the now line. Then the rows of the set: FIX-1467 carries a completed bar that ends before the now line, marked done and merged, and labelled not a proving leg; FIX-1468, FIX-1469 and FIX-1474 are short dashed backlog lanes with no bars, all three labelled not a proving leg, and FIX-1474 additionally marked NOT an ER-Collab gate; then the four exit-proof lanes, every one of which now holds a ticket and none of which carries a bar. FIX-1481 is In Spec Review and owns checklist rows 4 and 6 while verifying all six; FIX-1502 is Backlog, owns checklist row 5, and is marked BLOCKED BY FIX-1486; FIX-1496 is In Spec Review, filed September 22, and is the lane that stands the live hire up; FIX-1497 is Backlog with no spec, filed September 22, and held behind FIX-1481. A terminated stub marks FIX-1458 as canceled on September 20. The route to the done condition is drawn in the gutter as a broken line through the proof lanes, and every one of its dots is now in the accent colour because every proof has an owner, so the route is whole and entirely unrun. A note says every exit proof now has a lane with a ticket in it and not one carries a bar: filing is normal course under ER-23, and running is the proof. Under a divider, related lanes not in the set: kitchen-sink FIX-1455, a sibling epic that left the set; FIX-1320 flow instances, Spec Approved, which checklist rows 1 to 3 ride and W5 does not run; FIX-1486, Backlog, which blocks row 5 and which W5 must not build under ER-25; and FIX-1442 org never optional, wrap-gating.
svg.text: THE PATH — ONE LANE PER ROW OF THE SET, AGAINST TIME · SEP 22
